notes: Model-independent SN1987A cooling bound on QCD axion: f_a > 1.1e8 GeV, equivalently m_a < 5.3e-2 eV (68% C.L.). This excludes axion masses above 5.3e-2 eV. Note the paper's stated C.L. is 68%, not 90/95%; encoded confidence_level as 0.90 as nearest allowed value. Single bound point given; the exclusion is a vertical line in the m_a-1/f_a plane excluding heavier masses.
